title: AIWG Model Configuration
description: Default model mappings for AIWG SDLC framework deployment. Users can customize these values for their specific needs.

reasoning.description: Claude Opus 5 (pinned ID; premium tier) - Best for complex reasoning, architecture design, strategic decisions. Bare aliases inherit the parent session's variant and hit the credit-gated 1M path under a 1M parent (#1442); opt into 1M explicitly with --reasoning-model opus[1m].

coding.description: Claude Sonnet 5 (pinned ID; standard tier) - Best for code generation, implementation, debugging. Pinned so subagent dispatch never inherits a 1M-context parent (#1442, #2563); opt into 1M explicitly with --coding-model sonnet[1m].

efficiency.description: Claude Haiku 4.5 (pinned ID; economy tier) - Best for quick tasks, file operations, simple edits. Anthropic lists retirement not before 2026-10-15; re-verify then.

reasoning.description: Factory Heavy policy lets the provider select its current high-reasoning model

coding.description: Factory Medium policy lets the provider select its current coding model

efficiency.description: Factory Light policy lets the provider select its current low-cost model

reasoning.description: GPT-5.6 Sol - Premium tier; Codex 'latest frontier agentic coding model' (observed in Codex model/list 2026-09-21). GPT-6 Astra is the flagship and is user-elected only.

coding.description: GPT-5.6 Terra - Standard tier; 'balanced agentic coding model for everyday work' (observed 2026-09-21)

efficiency.description: GPT-5.6 Luna - Economy tier; 'fast and affordable agentic coding model' (observed 2026-09-21)

reasoning.description: Windsurf uses Claude models via API (experimental)

coding.description: Windsurf uses Claude models via API (experimental)

efficiency.description: Windsurf uses Claude models via API (experimental)

ollama._note: Local model defaults via Ollama. These are reasonable starting points — tune to your hardware.

reasoning.description: Llama 3.3 70B — closest to cloud reasoning quality locally, requires 48GB+ VRAM

coding.description: Qwen 2.5 Coder 14B — best coding quality per VRAM of validated local models (12GB VRAM)

efficiency.description: Qwen 3.5 9B — consumer hardware entry point with tool use and vision support (8GB VRAM)

_comments.usage: This file defines default model mappings used by AIWG deployment scripts
_comments.customization: Users can modify these values to use different models or versions
_comments.location: Place custom models.json in project root to override defaults
_comments.flagship: Flagship models (claude-fable-5-1, gpt-6-astra) are never assigned to a role by default. They are available only through explicit user election (e.g. --reasoning-model fable or --reasoning-model astra). See epic #2642.
_comments.claudeLongContext: Claude Code documents sonnet and sonnet[1m] as separate selectors. AIWG deploys pinned model IDs (claude-sonnet-5 etc.) because a bare alias inherits a 1M-context parent and subagent dispatch then hits the usage-credit gate (#1442, #2563); opt into 1M with --coding-model sonnet[1m] or sonnet-1m.
